title: Observer Failure Receipt v1
description: Closed ObserverFailureReceipt defined by Gate A1 design 03 §6.3 and §9.2. observerFailureFP uses the registered rg.gatea.observer-failure.v1 domain and excludes itself from the fingerprint payload.

observerFailureFP.description: TypedFP('rg.gatea.observer-failure.v1', receipt fields excluding observerFailureFP), encoded as a WireDigest.

observerId.description: PrincipalId of the Observer that attempted the observation.

producerOwner.description: Caller-owned ObserverAuthority PrincipalId; it must equal the producerOwner in the corresponding Evidence Catalog entry.

failureReason.description: Closed Gate A1 hermetic failure code observed by the Observer or its recovery boundary.

observedAt.description: Instant at which the failure was observed.

visibility.description: Visibility projection determined by the Evidence Catalog visibilityPolicyRef; authorization defaults to deny.
